subject: Carelytics — live-output toolchain orchestration & schema finalization
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@carelytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Carelytics | Live-output integration kickoff request

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your live-output summarization pipeline. We'd like to schedule a 60-minute kickoff to align on the implementation runway for streaming, tool/function calls, and the structured JSON output schema. Proposed agenda: 

- Goals & acceptance criteria for MVP (latency targets, token budget, schema contract)
- Connectivity and auth (VPC peering / API keys / allowed IPs)
- Streaming behaviour and fallback policies (partial responses, retries)
- Function/tool calling surfaces and expected side-effects (e.g., lookup gateway)
- Structured output JSON schema (examples + validation rules)
- Success metrics & rollout plan (canary, QA, production)

Are you available for a kickoff next week? I can do Tue 6/1 11:00–12:00 PT or Wed 6/2 14:00–15:00 PT. If you prefer, we can split into a 30-minute technical session + 30-minute PM session.

I'll include Marissa (CS lead) and Rishi (solutions) on the thread so we can capture pre-kickoff deliverables.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: —

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@carelytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Chen <alan.chen@carelytics.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Carelytics | Live-output integration kickoff request

Ben —

Thanks, Tue 6/1 11:00 PT works for us. I'll be there along with Alan (engineering) and our onboarding mailbox. A couple of notes ahead of the call so we can be efficient: 

- Our security team will want a short SOC 2 / data flow summary and a list of the logs/retention controls. Alan will bring the SOC 2 contact on the kickoff if needed.
- We have a strict naming convention for patient-facing keys (snake_case) and would like the JSON schema to follow it; I'll attach our internal schema examples after the call.
- We plan to route function/tool-calls through an internal microservice (lookup.redcare) — need to confirm expected latency and retry semantics.

Looking forward to the meeting — Tue 11AM PT.

Best,
Elaine Park
Director, Platform Integrations
Carelytics

Attachment: —

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@carelytics.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Carelytics | Live-output integration kickoff request

Marissa / Rishi —

FYI: Elaine confirmed Tue 11AM PT (6/1) and mentioned two inbound asks: SOC2/data-flow summary and adherence to snake_case for any patient-facing keys. They will route tool calls via lookup.redcare.

Can you please: 
1) Produce a one-page SOC2/dataflow summary we can share during the kickoff (Rishi)
2) Prepare a lightweight JSON validation harness we can run against their sample messages (Marissa)
3) Draft a minimal mutual action plan (MAP) with pre-kickoff deliverables (connectivity test, sample payloads, test API key)

Pre-kick checklist I'm thinking to share:
- Confirm IP allowlist and test endpoint
- Provide sample streaming payload (two examples: short conversation and long report)
- Schema first draft (Redwood) + their naming convention mapping
- Define success criteria for canary (p99 latency < 400ms, token cost target)

Attaching a quick pre-kick checklist. I'll run the kickoff and capture notes.

Thanks — Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@carelytics.com>, Alan Chen <alan.chen@carelytics.com>, Carelytics Onboarding <onboarding@carelytics.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Carelytics | Live-output integration kickoff request

Ben / team / Elaine —

Thanks for the heads-up. Per request, I've attached a first-pass schema (schema_v0.9.json) that follows our recommended structured-output patterns but respects a snake_case option for patient-facing fields. Also attached: a short onboarding_playbook.pdf that outlines test harness steps, mock replay instructions for streaming, and validation checkpoints.

Operational plan (high level):
- Week 0 (pre-kick): connectivity test, sample payload exchange, install test API key
- Week 1 (pilot): run mock replay of 1k messages against streaming endpoint; CS will run schema validation and report regressions
- Week 2 (canary): small production traffic with canary routing; Redwood monitors cost/latency and auto-fallback configured

Owners:
- Marissa: overall onboarding + schema validation
- Rishi: SOC2/dataflow note and platform security liaison
- Ben: stakeholder communications and MAP finalization

Please review schema_v0.9.json and call out any required field name changes. Elaine, Alan — if you can provide one or two representative sample documents (an encounter note and an insurance claim excerpt) before Monday, we'll run them through the harness.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0112

Thanks everyone — the attachments look good and the plan makes sense. A few quick items before we proceed to pilot:

- Schema: we prefer that any patient-facing identifiers use snake_case and the field currently named "patientId" in your draft be "patient_id". If you can push that change in schema_v0.9.json we can sign off.
- SOC2/dataflow: Rishi — please send the one-page summary to onboarding@carelytics.com; legal wants it by EOD Monday.
- SOW: I've attached a short SOW_draft.docx with our billing cadence and a 30-day acceptance window; Ben, can you review and loop in finance if needed?

On the kickoff notes — Alan will run the lookup.redcare latency test during the call; please allow time for a 10-minute connectivity exercise.

Quoted for context:
> Marissa: "Please review schema_v0.9.json and call out any required field name changes."

I'll upload the representative sample documents to the shared Confluence page by tomorrow and we'll be ready for the pre-kick test.

Best,
Elaine
